Project Name: Bexar County ADC Annex Elevator Upgrade
Location Address: 1211 W. Travis St., San Antonio, TX 78207
Type of Funds: This project involves public funds, public land, or is a Federally funded roadway project.
Scope of Work: Bexar County ADC intends to upgrade two existing hydraulic elevators, designated as Elevators #1 and #2, located in the Annex Building. These elevators are critical to moving inmates, meals, medications, and staff to housing units on the second floor
